summary: Template-grid reader (first-ink alignment, 8 fixed 12px cells, 10 hand-typed 15x12 templates, presence-based EOS) reaches exact match 1.000 / CER 0.000 on dev_main n=400, all lengths 1-8.
On 24 traced cases, template top1-top2 score gap is at least 11.5 (median 21.8) and presence ink separates present (>=40.9) from absent (<=1.6) cells by a wide margin.
Left bearing of the first glyph relative to its cell origin is 1 or 2 px in traced cases (offset choices 1 x20, 2 x4), so the 0..3 bearing search is sufficient for this font.
The design depends on fixed pitch (12 px) and glyph size; it will likely fail on other font sizes or proportional fonts without new templates and grid logic.
